title: Exclusive: Rune and Havoc Team Up for Contested Logistics | Rune Technologies News
summary: Defense logistics startup Rune and drone company Havoc announced a partnership integrating autonomous supply delivery technology onto unmanned systems for military operations in contested environments.
body_markdown:
Tectonic covered Rune Technologies by Erin O'Brien in a piece titled “Exclusive: Rune and Havoc Team Up for Contested Logistics.” Defense logistics startup Rune and drone company Havoc announced a partnership integrating autonomous supply delivery technology onto unmanned systems for military operations in contested environments.


Read the full article[here](https://www.tectonicdefense.com/exclusive-rune-and-havoc-team-up-for-contested-logistics/) .
